hero.headline: Your Digital
hero.subheadline: Store passwords, cards, secure notes, and files in one zero-knowledge encrypted vault. Your data never leaves your hands.

items.title: Password Manager
items.description: Store website logins with username, password, URL, and notes. One-click copy and reveal.

items.title: Cards & Finance
items.description: Debit and credit card details with masked display, CVV reveal, and bank info.

items.title: Secure Notes
items.description: Encrypted text notes for PINs, recovery codes, private thoughts, and sensitive data.

items.title: Files & Media
items.description: Upload and store documents, images, and videos with encrypted metadata.

items.title: Identity Vault
items.description: Passport, IC, driver's licence, and personal identity documents in one place.

items.title: PIN & Secret Data
items.description: Store PINs, secret codes, and any custom sensitive data with full encryption.

items.title: Create Your Vault
items.description: Sign up with your email and set a strong master password.

items.title: Add Your Secrets
items.description: Store passwords, cards, notes, and files in organised categories.

items.title: Access Anywhere
items.description: Your encrypted vault is available on any device, any time.

features.title: AES-256 Encryption
features.description: Every piece of data is encrypted with military-grade AES-256 before storage.

features.title: Zero-Knowledge Architecture
features.description: We never see your data. Encryption and decryption happen only on your device.

features.title: Neon Database Backend
features.description: Serverless Postgres with automatic backups and point-in-time recovery.

features.title: Session Security
features.description: Secure HTTP-only cookies with automatic expiry and session revocation.

checklist.text: End-to-end encrypted at rest and in transit
